# Azure DevOps Work Item Discovery

Scans every participant `azure-devops-project` entity, calls the Azure DevOps REST API to enumerate work items in that project, and upserts each one as an `azure-devops-work-item` entity keyed by the stable name path `["azure-devops", org, project, "work-items", id]` so re-runs update rather than duplicate.

## Configuration

Read from the tool entity's top-level properties (not a nested `configuration` object):

| Key | Type | Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| `personal-access-token` | string | Optional PAT used for the Azure DevOps REST calls. When absent, the tool reads the `AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN` environment variable. Store the token on a per-machine tool clone rather than the shared default. |
| `max-items` | integer | Maximum work items to fetch per project. Defaults to `200`. |

## Usage

Wire the tool via a `tool-relationship`:

- `participants.tool` — the entity-id of this tool entity.
- `participants.target` — one or more `azure-devops-project` entities whose organization/project URLs should be scanned.
- `participants.schedule` — a `schedule` entity governing how often the scan runs.

Set `paused: true` on the relationship to temporarily disable discovery without deleting it. The tool logs a scan summary (`Scanned N project(s). Upserted M work item(s).`) after each run.
